items.title: Why the Long Nose?
items.task: Look at the train’s nose. Why would engineers make it this shape?
items.reveal: A long nose helps the train move air aside. That cuts noise and the punch of air in tunnels.

moreInfo.title: Tunnel boom
moreInfo.text: A fast train entering a tunnel squeezes air. The long nose spreads that squeeze so nearby towns hear less boom.

items.notes: Lightweight optional. fragmentValue 0. Tunnel-boom wording still wants a later engineering pass; not in this fact-check batch.
